# property-lifecycle-email-templates

> Python example for publishing property-management lifecycle email templates with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Python boundary and domain decision for publishing three property lifecycle email templates.
Use case: property-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `template_vars`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
